units: studs; 1 Blender unit = 1 stud; all sizes/positions in Roblox Y-up
coordinate_note: Placements are hole-local (holes.json frame). world = R_y(world_yaw) * local + world_offset. pos is where the prop ORIGIN goes. yaw in degrees about +Y (CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw), 0)). Unrotated props face +Z unless 'front' says otherwise.

fbx_export.mapping: Blender (x, y, z) -> Roblox (x, z, -y): Blender +Y = Roblox -Z (north)

structure: Each FBX = one root (named <prop>) with one child mesh per material named <prop>__<Material>. All children share the prop origin. Import as a Model; each child becomes a MeshPart. Set MeshPart.Color / Material / Transparency from parts[] (the FBX material carries the same base colour). Neon parts are the glow cores: add a PointLight to them.

textures.uv: box (cube) projection in prop space; 1 repeat per tile_studs; side faces map V to height
textures.roblox: One texture per MeshPart (each <prop>__<Material> child is one MeshPart). Either add a SurfaceAppearance with ColorMap = the uploaded PNG (keeps Material for sound/physics, best look), or set MeshPart.TextureID. Keep MeshPart.Color = the flat colour as a fallback / LOD tint.

collision: Decoration only: set CanCollide=false, CanQuery=false, CanTouch=false, Anchored=true, CollisionFidelity=Box on every MeshPart. Gameplay collision comes from holes.json.

hole_skins.note: Pass 5 per-hole skins. felt_material: set the felt Parts/MeshParts of that hole to this colour/material (+ SurfaceAppearance ColorMap = felt_texture, NormalMap = textures/felt_normal.png). rail_*: use these rail-kit props on that hole's rail walls (same placement rule as the base kit).

axes.x: +X = along the forearm toward the FINGERS

axes.z: +Z = X cross Y = across the wrist (thumb side on a left arm; the mesh is mirror-symmetric in Z)

wrist_face.size_axes: 0.37 along +X (forearm), 0.28 along Z (across the wrist); flat quad, 2 tris, zero thickness
wrist_face.uv: 0..1 fills the quad exactly: U 0 -> 1 along +X (toward the fingers), V 0 -> 1 along -Z
wrist_face.surfacegui: SurfaceGui on WristFace, Face = Top (the +Y face); canvas 0.37 x 0.28 studs, e.g. SizingMode FixedSize CanvasSize 1024 x 784 (or PixelsPerStud ~2770). dressing.note: Pass 4 (world-corrected) set dressing. Every instance has world_pos [x, y, z] (y = base on Terrain), world_yaw and terrain_y (terrain height under the origin), plus the hole-local pos/yaw (pos.y corrected to the same world height: world = holeRoot * local, holeRoot = CFrame.new(world.json origin) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw_deg), 0)). Preferred import: one Model per instance from fbx/<prop>.fbx, Model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(world_pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(world_yaw), 0)); Model:ScaleTo(scale). Blockout alternative: fbx[] = the same instances merged per material (repeated pieces merged into a few MeshParts); ORIGIN CONVENTION: each dressing_hNN_* file is in the hole frame, origin = that hole's world.json placement origin, axes rotated by its yaw_deg -> Model:PivotTo(holeRoot). dressing_hNN_cards.fbx = far-field card clumps (alpha-cut textures). lights[] = glow-core centres (hole-local), lights_world[] = the same in world studs (PointLight Range 8, Brightness 0.6 day / 1.6 night, #FFB347). Terrain heights come from world/terrain-4stud.json (bilinear); if Studio Terrain differs, raycast down from world_pos + (0, 20, 0). Pass 5: role 'accent' = cup_lantern_stake beside the H8/H9 cups and the H9 root gate (marks = cup / root_gate). spot_lights[] (H8, H9) = extra PointLights pooling over the moving parts and cups: pos (hole-local), world_pos, color, range, brightness; host each on an invisible, non-colliding Attachment/Part at world_pos (all are >= 6.5 above the felt and outside every keep-out). Pass 6 (holes.json v2): the H9 lantern-bar spot is replaced by a spot beside the lantern_pendulum hinge (off the swing plane); H7 got a reserved share of its near field and an extra low-ground-cover / framing refill; stats.pass6_vs_pass5 = unchanged / moved / removed / added vs pass 5. Pass 7: H8 'Firefly Hollow' role 'hollow' (marks firefly_hollow:<area>) = firefly clusters / swarms, glow-shroom patches and glowing surface roots around the alcove, lane, climb and green, placed before the seed pass; H8 spot_lights kind 'firefly_glow' (over firefly_swarm:<k>, target_pos = the swarm's pos) sit ~2.4 above a swarm's base, off the felt, clear of every keep-out; stats.pass7_vs_pass6 lists what each hole gained / lost vs pass 6. Pass 7b: every plant instance (props[].category == 'plant', see rules.plant_rail_clearance) has rail_gap = exact horizontal distance from its whole mesh footprint to the nearest wall of any hole (>= 1.5; capped at 2.5, i.e. 2.5 means >= 2.5); stats.pass7b_vs_pass7 lists the pass-7 violators and the plants moved / removed. Pass 8: role 'hang' (H9 lantern_large_hanging, hanging=True: world_pos y = lantern bottom, 8 above the felt; NOT grounded, terrain_y is the ground under it) and role 'rail' (H7 rail_lantern_stake, H8 rail_lantern_crook; marks rail_lantern:<left|right>, wall, seq, chain_gap_before). Every one has light_id -> manifest.lights[] (its glow core is NOT repeated in lights[] / lights_world[]); H8 glow props also carry light_id. stats.pass8_vs_pass7b lists what each hole gained / lost.

budgets.definition: near-field tris of hole N = all dressing instances (any hole) whose origin lies within 60 studs of hole N's felt. Target well under 40k for Quest; enforced <= 34000.
budgets.far_field: every pass-2 backdrop clump (tree_backdrop_cluster, 834 tris) is replaced by a card clump (treeline_card_red / _gold, 3 crossed quads, 12 tris); refill beyond the near field uses cards only (>= 40 studs from their own felt, >= 26 from any felt).
budgets.no_lods: No separate LOD / far versions: Roblox auto-LODs MeshParts and streams nearby parts. Repeated pieces are merged per material in the fbx[] groups.

rules.ground: footprint terrain spread <= 1.5 (small props, lantern poles), <= 3 (trees), <= 3.5 (cards); no water cells
rules.tall_near_rail: pass 5: every prop taller than 2 studs keeps its footprint and all geometry below base + 5 >= 3 studs (horizontal) from every collision wall (rails, backings, boards, deflectors) of every hole
rules.plant_rail_clearance: pass 7b: every plant instance (category 'plant': fern_clump, fern_clump_large, glow_root_arch, glow_shroom_patch, glowing_mushrooms, gold_leaf_bush, grass_tuft, maple_sapling, orange_leaf_bush, red_bush_tall, red_leaf_bush, toadstool_cluster, toadstool_orange_cluster, toadstool_tall, toadstool_trio_small) keeps its whole mesh footprint (every triangle projected to XZ) >= 1.5 studs (horizontal) from every rail / collision wall of every hole; violators are nudged outward (same role) or removed

lights_note: Pass 8 PointLights (one per entry): pos = hole-local, world_pos = world studs (same frame as dressing world_pos). Create a PointLight with Color = Color3.fromRGB(color3), Range, Brightness, Shadows = false and parent it to the Neon part named in 'parent' (or an invisible, non-colliding Attachment at world_pos). kind hanging_lantern (H9, lantern_large_hanging), rail_lantern (H7 rail_lantern_stake / H8 rail_lantern_crook): amber Color3(255, 169, 87) ~2700K; firefly_glow_low / shroom_glow (H8): soft glow over the firefly clusters and glow mushrooms. The H8 firefly_glow spot_lights (dressing.holes.H8.spot_lights) were raised to Brightness 3.5, Range 14 in pass 8 (not repeated here).

emissive.note: Pass 8: brighter H8 glow. Firefly (fireflies, teleport rings, glowing-mushroom spots) and ShroomGlow (glow-mushroom caps) stay Neon with the same Color; preview emission Firefly 4 -> 8, ShroomGlow 3 -> 6. In Studio add a SurfaceAppearance to every *__Firefly / *__ShroomGlow MeshPart: ColorMap = the emissive texture, EmissiveMaskContent = glow_emissive_mask.png (white = all emissive), EmissiveStrength and EmissiveTint as below. If SurfaceAppearance emissive is unavailable, keep Neon and rely on the raised PointLights (spot_lights firefly_glow + lights[] firefly_glow_low / shroom_glow).

h9_emissive_dim.note: H9 brightness fix (Game Art Bot, Oct 11): glow on H9 lanterns + glowing mushrooms cut 30%. Roblox glow comes from Neon parts, whose glow scales with Color, so every *__Glow / *__Firefly / *__ShroomGlow part in the H9 props is re-exported as <prop>_h9dim with base colour x0.7 in sRGB (Blender preview emission also x0.7). Geometry, pivots, part names (with _h9dim inserted) and all other materials unchanged. Originals untouched, so H1-H8 keep full glow; use the _h9dim FBX ONLY for H9 placements. Shared props (cup_lantern_stake, hollow_tree, lantern_string, glowing_mushrooms, glow_shroom_patch/lantern_large_hanging etc baked into dressing_h09_a) are thus H9-specific variants.
